cases.title: BROKEN VARIANT of W784: the FROM switch is off, so P11 shows one merged row FROM "Cs" instead of C5 and C6 (must FAIL)
cases.expected: The twin claims what W784 claims (P11's group reads FROM C5 and FROM C6, never C or Cs). With the switch off CE shows one row FROM Cs at 17.80, so the C5, C6 and "no C or Cs" checks fail; the pit, pipe and window checks still pass.
cases.why_not_unit: As W784: the FROM text comes from the live window with the real Settings switch.
not_automated: The drawn Pit Schedule table (the after-command refresh of a FROM cell) is not driven: placing these rows in the drawn table needs 'Place schedule' or a proven 'Update existing schedule' route, and reading drawn cells is unproven on DRV1_B1. A Codex look covers it (report section 1).
Names CP3, SPS1 and an X-Civil GP4 are not typed; the rule is the same for any letters that are not a source tag. That a downpipe (DP1) still reads "DP" is not driven here.
The inlet levels in P11's rows are recorded, not asserted (the cell format of a new pipe's level is not yet seen on a run).
